faqs.question: What age is the Skyline Park suitable for?
faqs.answer: The Skyline Park is designed as a classic family park and offers attractions for truly all age groups. Even for toddlers from about three years of age, there are numerous gentle rides, petting zoos, and large playgrounds. At the same time, teenagers and adrenaline fans get their money's worth on the extreme roller coasters and upside-down rides.

faqs.question: What is the most extreme roller coaster in the Skyline Park?
faqs.answer: The "Sky Wheel" is considered one of the absolute highlights and the most extreme roller coaster in the entire park. It is one of the highest upside-down roller coasters in Europe, pulling you steeply into the air and through spectacular corkscrews without shoulder restraints. The "Sky Dragster", where you can control the speed of the vehicle yourself, also provides a massive adrenaline rush.

faqs.question: When does the Skyline Park open again in 2026?
faqs.answer: The season at Skyline Park traditionally begins in spring, usually shortly before the Bavarian Easter holidays at the end of March or beginning of April. The exact opening date for 2026 will be announced a few months in advance on the park's official website. It is recommended to check the current opening hours online again before your very first visit in the spring.

faqs.question: How high is the Allgäuflieger in the Skyline Park?
faqs.answer: The "Allgäuflieger" impresses with an incredible height of around 142 meters, making it the highest flying carousel in the world. During the ride, you not only enjoy the thrill of the height, but also a breathtaking panoramic view over the Unterallgäu all the way to the snow-capped Alps. The ride is an absolute must for all visitors who are completely free from a fear of heights.

faqs.question: Where exactly is the Skyline Park located?
faqs.answer: The Allgäu Skyline Park is located directly on the A96 motorway, which connects Munich with Lindau, right at the Bad Wörishofen exit. Postally, the site belongs to the neighboring municipality of Rammingen in the Bavarian district of Unterallgäu. Thanks to this direct motorway connection and a nearby dedicated train stop, the park is perfectly accessible by transport.

faqs.question: When is Halloween at the Skyline Park?
faqs.answer: The Halloween event at the Skyline Park usually takes place on several weekends from the end of October to the beginning of November. During this time, the park transforms into a family-friendly chamber of horrors with special horror mazes, spooky actors, and eerie decorations. During the day, there is a milder program for children, while in the evening things get significantly scarier for the braver adults.

faqs.question: When is FKK (nudism) at the Therme Bad Wörishofen?
faqs.answer: At the Therme Bad Wörishofen, the rule for textile-free bathing applies to the entire indoor area every Saturday from 7:00 PM. This means that from this time onwards, the large thermal bath area, just like the saunas, is used without swimwear. On all other days, the normal thermal bath area is to be used regularly with swimwear, while the sauna area remains strictly textile-free.

faqs.question: How much does a day pass cost at the thermal baths?
faqs.answer: A regular day pass for adults currently usually costs between 40 and 50 euros, depending on whether you visit only the thermal bath or also the vitality bath with saunas. On weekends and public holidays, a small tariff surcharge is often applied. The easiest way to find the exact and daily updated prices is on the thermal bath's booking website.

faqs.question: Do birthday guests get free admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, birthday guests receive completely free admission at the Therme Bad Wörishofen as a special gift on their special day. This applies to both children and adult guests, provided the exact date of birth is proven by an ID at the ticket office. This makes it an excellent way to use your birthday for a relaxing and also inexpensive break.

faqs.question: When is Happy Hour at the thermal baths?
faqs.answer: The thermal baths do not offer a classic "Happy Hour" for free drinks, but there are discounted evening rates. Those who visit the thermal baths only in the last few hours before closing time in the evening benefit from a noticeably reduced admission price. This rate is particularly suitable for working people who want to swim a few laps or relax in the thermal water after work.

faqs.question: Can you eat at the Therme Bad Wörishofen?
faqs.answer: Yes, your physical well-being is well catered for in the facility by its own thermal bath restaurant. A wide selection of fresh salads, light warm dishes, and exotic cocktails is offered right at the edge of the pool. You can conveniently have your food and drinks charged to your chip wristband and only have to pay when leaving the thermal baths.

faqs.question: Which diseases are treated in Bad Wörishofen?
faqs.answer: As the birthplace of Kneipp medicine, the treatment focus in Bad Wörishofen is on cardiovascular diseases, states of exhaustion, and metabolic disorders. The traditional Kneipp therapy with its cold water applications also helps very well with rheumatic complaints and sustainably strengthens the immune system. In addition, there are highly specialized clinics for orthopedics and psychosomatic rehabilitation on site.

faqs.question: Which places belong to Bad Wörishofen?
faqs.answer: In addition to the main town, several surrounding districts and villages also belong to the administrative city of Bad Wörishofen. The best-known districts are Dorschhausen, Frankenhofen, Kirchdorf, Schlingen, and Stockheim. These rather rural and traditional areas perfectly complement the bustling spa center and offer plenty of nature for those seeking peace and quiet.

faqs.question: When is the White Night in Bad Wörishofen?
faqs.answer: The "White Night" is one of the summer event highlights in the spa town and usually takes place in July. The city center transforms into a large, elegant open-air lounge where visitors traditionally appear dressed completely in white. Live music, open shops, and culinary offerings make this evening a special social experience.

faqs.question: What is the most beautiful lake in the Allgäu?
faqs.answer: The Alpsee near Füssen is often described as the most picturesque lake, as it lies directly below the famous royal castles and offers a magical panorama. However, the Großer Alpsee near Immenstadt is also very popular; as the largest natural lake in the Allgäu, it attracts sailors and hikers in particular. Ultimately, the region has countless mountain lakes, each with its own unique, charming character.

faqs.question: What is the warmest lake in the Allgäu?
faqs.answer: The Hopfensee near Füssen is considered one of the warmest pre-Alpine lakes in the entire Allgäu. Because it is relatively shallow, the water warms up very quickly in summer and often consistently reaches bathing temperatures of over 20 degrees Celsius. Due to these beautiful conditions and the promenade, the region around the Hopfensee is also affectionately called the "Allgäu Riviera".

faqs.question: What family swimming pools are there in the Allgäu?
faqs.answer: In addition to the large wellness thermal baths, there are great adventure pools for families in the Allgäu, such as the Alpspitz-Bade-Center (ABC) in Nesselwang with its large tube slide. The CamboMare in Kempten or the Wonnemar in Sonthofen also offer huge children's areas, wave pools, and fun slides. In summer, numerous beautifully situated natural outdoor pools and guarded bathing lakes also entice you out into the fresh air.

faqs.question: When do the mountain huts in the Allgäu open in 2026?
faqs.answer: Most serviced mountain huts in the Allgäu traditionally open their doors in late spring, usually from mid-May or early June 2026. However, this depends extremely heavily on the current snow conditions in the higher areas, as the alpine access paths must be safe to walk on. Some lower-lying alpine pastures often open on beautiful April weekends if the weather conditions are good.

faqs.question: When is the cattle drive (Almabtrieb) in the Allgäu in 2026?
faqs.answer: The cattle drive, traditionally known in the Allgäu as "Viehscheid", marks the end of the mountain summer. In 2026, most of these festive Viehscheid events will take place from mid-September into the first week of October. Since the exact festival dates vary from valley to valley, you should check the holiday region's event calendar starting in early summer.

faqs.question: What is Allgäu in English?
faqs.answer: There is no direct English word or translation for the geographical proper name "Allgäu". In the English-speaking world, the region is usually described in texts as "the Allgäu", "Allgäu Alps", or simply as a "region in southern Germany". In international travel guides, it is almost always left in its original German name for reasons of authenticity.

faqs.question: Is the Allgäu expensive to live in?
faqs.answer: Real estate and rental prices in the Allgäu vary extremely strongly depending on the exact geographical location. In absolute tourist hotspots like Oberstdorf or around the lakes, prices are very high and sometimes comparable to major cities. In more rural areas of the Lower Allgäu or away from the Alpine axis, however, you can still live much more affordably and spaciously.

faqs.question: Who owns the Allgäu?
faqs.answer: The Allgäu is not an independent political state or the property of a specific institution, but a historically and culturally developed landscape. It extends mainly over the southwestern part of Bavaria and the southeastern part of Baden-Württemberg. A tiny, alpine part also reaches across the border into the neighboring Austrian states.

faqs.question: How old is the city of Wangen im Allgäu?
faqs.answer: The picturesque city of Wangen im Allgäu looks back on a very eventful history spanning over 1,200 years. The first documented mention of the settlement dates back to the year 815, and in the 13th century, Wangen officially received extensive city rights. This impressively long history is still reflected today in the almost completely preserved medieval old town.

faqs.question: When is the market in Wangen im Allgäu?
faqs.answer: The traditional and popular weekly market in Wangen takes place every Wednesday. From the early morning hours until noon, regional vendors offer fresh fruit, Allgäu cheese, and artisanal products on the market square. It is not only a place to shop but an important weekly meeting point for locals and tourists alike.

faqs.question: When is the market in Isny im Allgäu?
faqs.answer: In the historic town of Isny, the classic weekly market traditionally takes place every Thursday morning. Around the pedestrian zone, fresh, regional produce is then offered directly by agricultural producers from the surrounding area. In addition, Isny hosts special historical artisan markets several times a year, which attract visitors from all over the region.

faqs.question: What is the name of the mayor of Isny?
faqs.answer: The current mayor of the town of Isny im Allgäu is Alessandro Boggia. He heads the town's administration and is strongly committed to economic development, sustainable tourism, and the preservation of the historic town center. Under his leadership, many future-oriented projects in the area of urban infrastructure are also being advanced.

faqs.question: At what altitude is Oy-Mittelberg in the Allgäu located?
faqs.answer: The municipality of Oy-Mittelberg is located at a very impressive altitude of about 1,000 meters above sea level. Due to this exposed high altitude, the town is considered particularly snow-sure in winter and offers a wonderfully fresh therapeutic climate in summer. In addition, from the elevations of the municipality, you have an unobstructed, fantastic panoramic view of the entire Allgäu Alps mountain range.

faqs.question: How much does 1 week of parking at Memmingen Airport cost?
faqs.answer: The cost of one week of parking at Allgäu Airport varies depending on the distance of the parking lot to the terminal and the exact time of booking. If you book early online, you can often secure a cheap long-term parking space like P11 for around 40 to 50 euros per week. Directly on site and in the parking areas very close to the terminal, the fees are noticeably higher.

faqs.question: Where can I park upon arrival at the airport?
faqs.answer: If you are picking someone up directly at the terminal, it is best to use the "Kiss & Fly" area in front of the building or parking lot P1. The very first 10 minutes in the "Kiss & Fly" zone are usually free and ideal for a quick pick-up. If you stay longer due to flight delays, high short-term fees apply, which is why P1 is usually the better and more relaxed choice for waiting times over 15 minutes.

faqs.question: What does co-working mean in German?
faqs.answer: The English term "co-working" is best translated into German as "gemeinschaftliches Arbeiten" (collaborative working). It describes a modern, urban working model in which freelancers, creatives, or employees of different companies share a large, open office. Everyone works on their own projects there, but benefits from the shared office equipment and the company.

faqs.question: What do you actually do when co-working?
faqs.answer: When co-working, you go about your normal professional activities – mostly digitally on a laptop – but simply not isolated in your home office. You flexibly rent a desk, use the fast internet, the printers, and the shared coffee kitchen of the space. During breaks, you naturally exchange ideas with other people, often from different industries, which frequently leads to new, creative ideas.

faqs.question: What is a co-working area?
faqs.answer: A co-working area describes the physical space or the entire building in which this collaborative work is realized. This area is typically divided into open zones for communicative work and quieter retreats or booths for important phone calls. Modern areas also place extremely high value on cozy lounge areas that promote networking and well-being.
